title: Migrate a 5,000-line generated rule table to its v2 interface, rule by rule
prompt:
rules.py in the current directory is our generated table of record-validation rules (about 5,000 lines: 230 rule functions and the RULES registry at the end). The generator is gone, so the file has to be migrated in place to the v2 rule interface that MIGRATION.md describes: every rule function, with its code table, the retired and merged rules, and the per-rule exceptions it lists. Behaviour the document does not change must stay exactly as it is.

tests/test_rules.py has examples of the v2 behaviour for a few rules; run them from this directory with `/usr/bin/python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`. More tests than these check every rule.

Code must run on /usr/bin/python3 (Python 3.9), the interpreter the checks use; standard library only. Do not modify MIGRATION.md or tests/test_rules.py.
